title: RC Circuits (charging)
theory: Charging through R: $q(t) = C\mathcal{E}\left(1 - e^{-t/RC}\right)$, $i(t) = \dfrac{\mathcal{E}}{R}e^{-t/RC}$; time constant $\tau = RC$. **Exam shortcuts:** at $t = 0$ an uncharged capacitor behaves as a plain wire ($V = 0$); as $t \to \infty$, as an open switch ($i = 0$). Most MEXT items need only the two limits, not the exponential.
